solutions.text:
Multiplying by \(\sqrt{x+10}\) gives \[ x+4=5\sqrt{x+10}. \] Squaring produces \[ \begin{gathered} x^2-17x-234\\ =(x-26)(x+9)\\ =0. \end{gathered} \] The value \(x=26\) satisfies the original equation, while \(x=-9\) makes its left side \(1-6=-5,\) not \(5.\) Thus \(-9,\) which lies between \(-10\) and \(-6,\) is extraneous.

The correct answer is B.
